purpose: Teach: 南東/電電/ヴォーカル/長調/小麦粉/エッセー/豪快/マーカー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家の方角が南東向きって自慢してたな
lines.en: Riku, weren't you literally bragging that your house faces southeast?
lines.style: Lazy teasing drawl, smirk audible, sharp little kick of emphasis landing on bragging.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で電電公社民営化習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You did that social studies unit on the phone corporation going private, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Low mumbled start, voice cracking slightly upward mid-question, feigning less interest than he has.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、軽音部でヴォーカル担当だったろ
lines.en: And you were on vocals in the light music club, weren't you?
lines.style: Quick and pointed, mock-innocent lift at the end, clearly enjoying having receipts.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽で長調の曲練習してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were stuck practicing that major-key piece in music class, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Flat deadpan comeback, slight speed-up, the barest smile leaking through the last word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家庭科で小麦粉のグルテンの実験したろ
lines.en: Didn't you do that gluten experiment with flour in home ec?
lines.style: Rapid-fire Kansai rhythm, exaggerated disbelief on gluten, needling but friendly underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語のエッセー、つまりエッセー課題書いたろ、桜
lines.en: And you had to write that essay assignment for Japanese class, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Mumbling volley returned, low and quick, tiny defensive edge sharpening into the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、豪快なジョークでクラスを笑わせてたな
lines.en: You did have the whole class dying with that ridiculous joke, though.
lines.style: Grudging grin breaking the sarcasm, slower and warmer, an actual compliment sneaking out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノートに蛍光マーカー塗りまくってたろ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, and your notes are basically pure highlighter at this point, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry closing jab, unhurried, a real half-laugh escaping on the final word.
